about_the_game:
Lead the Last Exodus

Expedition  Exodus is Earth’s last chance to colonize Mars. Keep your colonists alive, your domes running, and wipe out the Marsect bugs that attack every night.

Pick one of three ways to win:

Military: Build turrets, command mechs, and nuke every Marsect nest you find.

Farming: Raise crops in greenhouses, grow forests, and make Mars’ air safe to breathe.

Mining: Drill for rare ores, trade with Earth, dig and build huge underground cities.

Protect the colony, crush the Marsects, and turn Mars into home.

Your Mission Begins

1X. Explore

Send your colonists out to search for rare ores. Use it to build living domes for colonists, craft stronger defenses, or sell it to Earth for extra cash. Every expedition might also uncover clues about the expedition attempts that came before you.

2X. Expand

Your first dome is the first mark of civilization dominating Mars. Expand your colonies across the 30 zones of Mars with transportation, automation, and grit. But beware: Marsects don’t take kindly to new neighbors.

3X. Exploit

Mining Expeditions: Deploy drilling rigs to uncover rare resources like Iron, Titanium, and Uranium. These ores fuel your colony’s most advanced tech and military systems. And with Earth running dry on precious ores, every shipment you sell stabilizes humanity’s future on both planets.

Bug Raids: Don’t wait for the swarm. Form combat units to breach Marsect nests, and torch the swarm from the inside out with nuclear missiles. Eliminate the threat at its source and secure safe ground to build a future that lasts.

4X. Exterminate

When night falls, the Marsect swarms arrive. Command colonists and mechs in real-time combat. Defend your domes and send mechs to move deep into Marsect nest territory. Every night is a test of your walls, weapons, and your will.

5. Tech Tree

Unlock powerful Tech Trees in Farming, Mining, and Military. Supercharge food production, automate ore extraction, and load your mechs with nukes. Whether you’re feeding the colony or nuking a Marsect nest, it all starts here.

6. Dynamic Colonists

These colonists feel everything and they won’t shut up about it. They’ll laugh in the greenhouse, flirt and raise kids, and name their rovers “Marsmobile.” When you upgrade the  Skill Tree, Medics heal faster, Farmers harvest more, and Mech Pilots become trigger-happy. Watch your colony grow into a thriving community.
